name: Enos
overview: Enos, also called Enosh, is introduced in Scripture as the son of Seth, born after Seth had lived 105 years (Genesis 5:6). His birth marks a significant moment where 'men began to call upon the name of the LORD' (Genesis 4:26), indicating a renewed focus on worship and dependence on God. Enos lived for 905 years, fathering Cainan and other children, continuing the godly lineage established through Seth (Genesis 5:9-10). This brief account highlights Enos’s role in the early generations of humanity as a figure associated with calling on the Lord and the continuation of God's covenantal line.
